title: Crossing Linguistic Horizons: Finetuning and Comprehensive Evaluation of Vietnamese Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual substitution of general and male terms/pronouns with female equivalents in prompts to assess performance disparities (fairness). Additionally, measuring demographic representation frequencies and stereotypical occupational associations in open-ended model generations.

Counterfactual name substitution in prompts by converting Western names to Vietnamese equivalents using a Named Entity Recognition model to evaluate fairness. The study also measures demographic representation frequencies and stereotypical associations for racial groups in generated outputs.
